label: PATHWAY
conventions: Shared-head coordination (e.g. 'arginine and proline metabolism') is ONE span. Test: delete the other conjunct - if what remains is not a pathway name on its own, do not split.
A list of distinct heads must be split into one span per item.
If a coordination is only partly marked, the narrow span stays a TP and the full string is recorded as an FN carrying the correct boundary.
A trailing 'pathway'/'pathways' may stay inside the span; a trailing 'metabolites'/'rate'/'efficiency'/'flux'/'genes'/'disorders' changes the referent and must be excluded.
When a disease/gene-set phrase embeds a nameable pathway, span the pathway part ('Urea cycle disorders' -> 'Urea cycle').
